The first free early preview of Greylight.

- Camera RAW Process: catalogues, RAW development on rotary dials, and opening Lightroom Classic catalogues
- Graphics: layers, masks, adjustment layers, selections, brushes, type and 16-bit colour
- Designing and Illustration: pen paths, shapes and artboards with SVG export
- Sign in once with Google; Greylight greets you and tells you when there's a new version
- Help > Send feedback goes straight to the Greylight team

Requires: macOS 12 Monterey or newer (Apple silicon and Intel); Windows 10 version 1809 or newer, 64-bit.
